title: Software Development Engineer II C++ (m/f/d)

You'll work in a highly collaborative environment where innovation and creativity are embraced. If you're excited about the potential of technology to transform industries and improve lives, we invite you to join our dynamic team! We are on a mission to develop cutting-edge software solutions that empower users to harness the full potential of 3D data. You'll have the opportunity to work with a diverse group of talented individuals who are committed to pushing boundaries and driving advancements in the geospatial industry. Together, we create software that meets the needs of our users and contributes to social and environmental progress. Join us, and be part of a culture that values curiosity, growth, and collaboration. Your expertise will help shape the future of our products and the experiences of our growing community of users. Let's embark on this exciting journey together! What we offer Responsibility and impact Passionate and supportive working culture Flat hierarchies Emphasis on team and personal growth through personal coaching and staff development events Strong focus on company culture: appreciative, compassionate communication, enabling and embracing diversity High-profile team that is driven by the pursuit of excellent results Active ambition to become a technology leader in 3D reconstruction technology Well-appointed office environment and equipment in the center of Stuttgart Part of Esri, a global organization based in California focused on GIS and spatial analytics to enable global change Attractive compensation including benefits like public transport, leased e-bikes, and fitness Who we are We are an international team of young and enthusiastic individuals passionate about creating professional photogrammetry software and providing value for our customers. We understand that diversity, equity, and inclusion is not a destination but an ongoing process. title: Testingenieur*in Elektromechanik / Hardware Test Engineer
description: Wie wäre es, wenn deine Tests nicht das Ende der Entwicklung wären – sondern der Anfang? Wir bei TWK entwickeln und produzieren seit über 60 Jahren im Wachstumsmarkt der Mess- und Automatisierungstechnik kundenspezifische Sensoren für den Anlagen- und Maschinenbau. Funktionale Sicherheit für Mensch und Maschine ist unser Anspruch- oberflächliche Tests oder fehlende statistische Absicherung werden dem nicht gerecht. Deshalb legen wir Wert auf eine methodische und nachvollziehbare Testdurchführung und entwickeln diesen Bereich gezielt weiter. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams am Standort Düsseldorf suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt in Vollzeit als Spezifikations- und Testingenieur*in. Aufgaben In vielen Unternehmen wird Testing als Anhängsel der Entwicklung angesehen oder man glaubt, KI könne alles ersetzen, statt erst einmal die richtigen Probleme zu identifizieren. Bei uns ist das anders: Du wirst frühzeitig in die Produktentwicklung eingebunden und begleitest den gesamten Prozess – von Spezifikationen und Anforderungen über Tests und Verifikation bis zur Zertifizierung. Dabei trägst du Verantwortung für die Zuverlässigkeit und Leistungsfähigkeit unserer elektromechanischen Komponenten. Du stimmst dich eng mit den Entwicklungsingenieuren ab, verfeinerst gemeinsam Spezifikationen und bringst deine Ergebnisse direkt in Produktentscheidungen ein. Analytisch, pragmatisch und auf Augenhöhe – wer eine bessere Lösung sieht, spricht sie an. So sieht deine Arbeit konkret aus: Spezifikation und Pflege von Anforderungen, Testfällen und Testplänen nach geltenden Normen und Produktanforderungen Durchführung von Tests sowie Analyse und Dokumentation der Ergebnisse – beispielsweise Integrations-, Funktions-, Grenz-, Fehlerfall- und Klimatests Entwicklung von Testaufbauten und Testautomatisierungen zur Sicherstellung effizienter Testabläufe Durchführung von Hardware- und Softwaretests, insbesondere Unit- oder Modultests Qualifikation Wir suchen keine Checklisten-Erfüller, sondern Menschen, die Verantwortung für Qualität übernehmen wollen und mit analytischem Denken echte Schwachstellen aufdecken. Wenn du dich hier wiedererkennst, passt du zu uns: Was du mitbringst: Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik, Maschinenbau oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation Sicherer Umgang mit Datenblättern, Schaltplänen und technischen Handbüchern Erfahrung im Umgang mit gängigen Mess- und Prüfgeräten wie Oszilloskop, Logic Analyzer, Multimeter und Signalgenerator Grundlegende Erfahrung im Bereich Scripting oder Programmierung (z. B. B. Jira oder Confluence Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Spezifikation von Tests für elektromechanische Komponenten und Systemen Benefits Warum TWK? Weil hier mehr zählt als Obstkorb und Parkplatz. Ja, wir haben Deutschlandticket, Dienstrad und Wellhub – aber dafür wechselst du nicht den Job, oder? Das hier macht den Unterschied: Familienunternehmen mit Biss. Langjährig geführt, aber mit einer jungen Geschäftsleitung, die gestalten will statt verwalten. Das merkst du im ersten Gespräch. Wir investieren. Richtig. Erstes Gespräch online, zweites vor Ort in Düsseldorf. Ganz entspannt. Kein Bullshit, keine leeren Versprechen – nur ehrliche Arbeit in einem Unternehmen, das vorwärts will. title: Senior Linux Distribution & Validation Engineer
description:
Senior: GBP 73,500 - 99,500 
Staff: GBP 97,300 - 131,700

Subject to alignment to the responsibilities and duties of the role - we currently have multiple positions available at both Senior and Staff level.  

About the job 

Build the Linux distribution foundation that turns upstream software into trusted Graphcore platform releases. 

You will help create the Linux distribution that powers Graphcore AI systems. The team produces production-ready system images from proven upstream distributions. 

Your work will shape how releases are built, validated and prepared for deployment. You will strengthen the engineering path from upstream Linux software to dependable platform releases. 

You will build and improve automated pipelines, run established Linux test suites, and diagnose issues across build and validation flows. As the platform evolves, you will introduce controlled configuration and tuning changes with evidence-led validation. 

This is hands-on systems engineering with visible impact. You will help define reliable processes for a new team building a critical part of Graphcore’s platform. 

The team and culture 

You will join one of Graphcore’s newest engineering teams, helping shape its culture from the start. It is a small, co-located team where ownership matters and progress is visible. 

Work happens through close technical discussion, practical problem-solving and evidence-led decisions. Ideas are challenged openly, and the best path wins regardless of hierarchy. 

You will report to a leader who values technical credibility and invests in people’s growth. The team moves with pace, takes responsibility and changes direction when the evidence demands it. 

What we're looking for 

  • Strong practical experience working in Linux environments 
  • Experience building or maintaining automated CI/CD pipelines for reliable engineering workflows 
  • Proficiency in Python, Bash or similar scripting languages 
  • Experience with Linux image creation, provisioning or system installation 
  • Ability to diagnose failures in automated build or test environments 
  • Confidence using established tools while continuously improving engineering quality 

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. If you meet most of our essential criteria, we encourage you to submit an application and showcase how your background makes you a strong candidate. 

Benefits

  • Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
  • Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
  • Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
  • Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success
  • Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day
  • Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
  • Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover
  • Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.

Sponsorship

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry. 

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

description: Company Description Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries. Job Description The Software Engineer (.NET/Azure) is a hands-on, mid-level contributor responsible for designing, building, and modernizing high-volume, high-transaction applications across the Experian Employer Services (EES) organization. You will write production code, participate in code reviews, evaluate SAST findings, and work closely with product, quality engineering, security, and operations partners to deliver secure, reliable software to our clients and partners. AI and automation are the main focus of our team. EES is adopting an AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI DLC) and spec-driven agentic development, in which teams define intent, constraints, acceptance criteria, and validation before AI agents build approved work. As an engineer in this model you will work from versioned specifications, direct AI coding agents to implement approved work, and oversee the review, testing, and security validation of what they produce. You will have already worked this way hands-on; this is a requirement of the role, not a learning goal. Humans remain accountable for technical decisions, data protection, and production outcomes. At Experian, we believe great work happens when people come together. We're focused on attracting talent in and around our designated hub locations who are open to collaborating with colleagues in person. Aligning employees to these talent markets helps foster collaboration, strengthen team connections, and support long-term career growth within Experian. This hybrid role reports to the Engineering Manager, Application Engineering, and reside in or near one of our collaboration hubs: Costa Mesa, CA; San Jose, CA; Allen, TX; Austin, TX; Franklin, TN; New York, NY; Schaumberg, IL; Washington, D.C.; Atlanta, GA; Boston, MA; Seattle, WA Responsibilities: Analyze new feature requirements with attention to design, software development best practices, testing strategy, database design, security, and cloud architecture, and turn them into clear, versioned specifications with explicit acceptance criteria that engineers and AI agents can verify. Use AI coding assistants and agents (for example GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) to implement approved work, and own the review, testing, and security validation of AI-generated code before it is merged. Decide when a change needs additional human review based on its risk. Build new and modernize existing .NET applications, APIs, and partner integrations, including responsive, accessible web UIs that work across devices. Write high-quality, well-tested code: unit tests, integration tests, and contract tests, with observability built in. Automate repetitive engineering and operational work (pipelines, environment setup, test data, deployments) rather than performing it by hand. Maintain the team's reusable agent instructions, skills, and coding standards for the codebase, and help teammates use agentic tools well. Participate in code reviews and provide meaningful feedback on human-written and AI-generated code alike. Follow Experian's Secure SDLC. Evaluate and resolve SAST findings, handle sensitive and personal data safely, and never expose such data to AI tools or non-production environments without approved controls. Resolve defects identified by quality engineering and demonstrate completed functionality to the Product team for approval. Promote a DevOps culture, work with IT and operations, and participate in the on-call rotation for platform emergencies. Work within Agile and Scrum delivery while adapting planning and reporting as specifications and system-generated evidence replace ceremony-driven tracking. Qualifications Hands-on experience with spec-driven agentic development (mandatory). At least one year of personally using AI coding assistants or agents on production code: working from specifications, constraining the agent's scope, testing and reviewing its output, and deciding what requires human approval. Experience designing, building, and integrating REST APIs and partner integrations, including authentication, versioning, and error handling. Solid front-end experience with HTML, CSS, TypeScript, and one modern SPA framework (Angular or React). Experience with service oriented or microservice architecture, messaging, and common cloud-native patterns. Experience with Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, Git branching workflows, and automated testing in the pipeline. Working knowledge of secure coding practices, SAST remediation, and handling of sensitive and personal data. Experience with Agile and Scrum delivery. Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Experience building GenAI-enabled features with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Semantic Kernel, or similar, including retrieval-augmented generation, prompt engineering, and output evaluation.
